subject.title: feat(ui): session diff panel showing a session checkout's changes in chat

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `sessions.diff` as a permanent core Gateway method and first-party Control UI review surface after the correctness blockers are fixed?
rationale: This PR creates a new protocol contract and product workflow, and the protected maintainer signal means implementation correctness alone cannot determine long-term core ownership.

options.title: Sponsor the core feature
options.body: Accept the direction and require the resource-bound fixes, clean rebase, and real-flow proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the surface
options.body: Keep a smaller generic seam or experimental UI while deferring the permanent Gateway protocol contract.

options.title: Decline the direction
options.body: Close the linked issue and this PR if session-diff review should not live in OpenClaw core.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core feature
recommendation.body: Accept the direction and require the resource-bound fixes, clean rebase, and real-flow proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged ownership of the adjacent session-review and Control UI surfaces makes this the strongest available routing candidate.
